title: Spelling the violinist and cellist in the band
summary: The violinist Carl Mauderer and the Belgian cellist Marcel Guermann are named and spelled.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Thank God we got somebody to spell. These names are really hard, like Lelke. And you know, I can't figure out how to spell. Marcel German, how was it German?
Oh, he was a cellist. G-U-E-R-M-A-N-N. G-U-E-R. G-U-E-R. He was Flemish, I think. Either Flemish or pure Belgian, whatever it is. He was a nut.
